x: This season has seen many new additions to the Field Events ranks of our Club, and gradually we are building up a splendid body of young men interested in throwing and jumping events. George Powell merits our congratulations upon again winning the Southern Javelin Championship; and E.
Jones (34 ft. 11½ ins.) represented us in the Shot Putt. In the Surrey County Championship George Powell had his usual win with the Javelin (165 ft. 3½ ins.), with another of ours, E.
As regards the Field Events, we have a brighter side to the picture. Our men won the Javelin with E.
Championship, won both Pole Vault and High Jump, and was third in the Long Jump. Others to show up well have been E.
Jones took second place in the Shot and third in the Javelin. E.
Worrad form a powerful trio who gain us many points in Club matches. In the Javelin, E.
